hands.verdict: VERDICT: coder: The mobile test helper does not compile. In `crates/openagents-mobile/src/link_tests.rs`, the closure `file_rows` at line 1397 is declared as `|f: &Fixture|` and calls `f.link.packet()` at line 1398. `Link::packet` takes `&mut self` (`crates/openagents-mobile/src/account_link.rs:2256`), so that call borrows through a shared reference and produces the E0596 error. This is the one error behind both `check:openagents-mobile` and `test:openagents-mobile`. Fix: change the closure parameter to `f: &mut Fixture` and call it as `file_rows(&mut f)` at lines 1407 and 1442. The fixture binding must be `let mut f`, which it already needs for `f.link.act(...)`. Then rerun `cargo test --tests --manifest-path crates/openagents-mobile/Cargo.toml`. The rest of the diff (the `MessageFile` and `Message` changes, `link_view.rs`, and the Swift and Kotlin edits) is not implicated by these two failures.
